## Setup

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, error = FALSE, cache = FALSE, echo = TRUE, dpi = 300, fig.retina = 1, 
    fig.align = "center", dev = "png", dev.args = list(type = "cairo", family = "Arial"))
library(here)
current_file <- "Clinical_transcriptomic_associations"
output_dir_data <- here::here("output", current_file)
output_dir_figs <- here::here("docs", "figure", paste0(current_file, ".Rmd"))
dir.create(output_dir_data, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(output_dir_figs, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(here::here("output", "Datasets"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
set.seed(20240606)

# One rounded age per donor is shared by RNA and proteomics analyses.
donor_ages <- read.csv(here::here("data", "Donor_ages.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(donor_ages$Sample), donor_ages$Age_years[donor_ages$Sample == "CZD7"] == 38)
set_donor_age <- function(x) {
    is_seurat <- inherits(x, "Seurat")
    md <- if (is_seurat) x[[]] else x
    if (is.data.frame(md) && all(c("Sample", "Age_years") %in% names(md))) {
        j <- match(trimws(as.character(md$Sample)), donor_ages$Sample)
        present <- !is.na(md$Sample) & nzchar(trimws(as.character(md$Sample)))
        stopifnot(!anyNA(j[present]))
        x$Age_years <- donor_ages$Age_years[j]
    }
    x
}
```

## read CM

```{r read_CM}
DCM_RV <- set_donor_age(qs2::qs_read(here::here("data", "processed", "RV_cell_states_RNA.qs2"), nthreads = 2))
DCM_RV <- subset(DCM_RV, subset = Group == "DCM")
Idents(DCM_RV) <- "cell_type"
DefaultAssay(DCM_RV) <- "RNA"
```

## NormalizeData

```{r NormalizeData}
DefaultAssay(DCM_RV) <- "RNA"
DCM_RV <- NormalizeData(DCM_RV)
```

## 

```{r analysis_3}
Clinical_data <- set_donor_age(read_excel(here::here("data", "DCM_Clinical_data_22.xlsx")))
add_metadata <- DCM_RV[[]] %>% dplyr::select(Sample) %>% left_join(Clinical_data, by = "Sample")
row.names(add_metadata) <- row.names(DCM_RV[[]])
cols_to_overwrite <- setdiff(colnames(Clinical_data), "Sample")
DCM_RV@meta.data[, cols_to_overwrite] <- NULL
DCM_RV <- AddMetaData(DCM_RV, metadata = add_metadata)
rm(add_metadata, Clinical_data, cols_to_overwrite)
```

## metadata

```{r metadata}
DCM_RV$TAPSE_sPAP <- DCM_RV$TAPSE_mm/DCM_RV$sPAP_mmHg
table(DCM_RV$TAPSE_sPAP)
metadata <- DCM_RV@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(Sample, Batch_processing:CO_l.min, TAPSE_sPAP) %>% unique() %>% 
    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("LVID_mm", "RVOT_mm")))
metadata <- metadata %>% dplyr::select(1:3, 5, 6, 4, 7:ncol(metadata)) %>% dplyr::arrange(match(Sample, names(table(DCM_RV$Sample))))
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$Sample
all.equal(metadata$Sample, names(table(DCM_RV$Sample)))
reactable(metadata, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
metadata_DCM <- metadata %>% dplyr::filter(Group == "DCM")
stopifnot(all(metadata_DCM$Group == "DCM"), !anyDuplicated(metadata_DCM$Sample))
write.csv(metadata_DCM, file.path(output_dir_data, "A_clinical_donor_metadata.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Speckle all

```{r Speckle_all}
differential_abundance <- data.frame()
props <- getTransformedProps(DCM_RV$cell_type, DCM_RV$Sample, transform = "logit")
for (i in 7:(length(metadata_DCM))) {
    metadata_subset <- metadata_DCM[complete.cases(metadata_DCM[[i]], metadata_DCM$Age_years), ]
    props_subset <- props
    props_subset$Counts <- props$Counts[, metadata_subset$Sample, drop = FALSE]
    props_subset$TransformedProps <- props$TransformedProps[, metadata_subset$Sample, drop = FALSE]
    props_subset$Proportions <- props$Proportions[, metadata_subset$Sample, drop = FALSE]
    metadata_subset <- metadata_subset %>% arrange(Sample, colnames(props_subset$Proportions))
    design <- model.matrix(~metadata_subset[[i]] + metadata_subset[["Age_years"]])
    fit <- lmFit(props_subset$TransformedProps, design)
    fit <- eBayes(fit, robust = TRUE)
    differential_abundance_temp <- topTable(fit, n = Inf, coef = 2)
    differential_abundance_temp$metadata <- colnames(metadata_subset[i])
    differential_abundance_temp$cell_state <- rownames(differential_abundance_temp)
    differential_abundance <- rbind(differential_abundance, differential_abundance_temp)
}
rm(metadata_subset, props_subset, design, fit, differential_abundance_temp)
rownames(differential_abundance) <- NULL
differential_abundance <- dplyr::arrange(differential_abundance, adj.P.Val)
write.csv(differential_abundance, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "DCM_RV_Differential_Abundance.csv"), quote = F, 
    row.names = F)
reactable(differential_abundance, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
```

## Speckle CO l.min

```{r Speckle_CO_l_min, fig.height=4, fig.width=4}
metadata_subset <- metadata[complete.cases(metadata[["CO_l.min"]]), ]
props_subset <- props
props_subset$Counts <- props$Counts[, metadata_subset$Sample, drop = FALSE]
props_subset$TransformedProps <- props$TransformedProps[, metadata_subset$Sample, drop = FALSE]
props_subset$Proportions <- props$Proportions[, metadata_subset$Sample, drop = FALSE]
metadata_subset <- metadata_subset %>% arrange(Sample, colnames(props_subset$Proportions))
design <- model.matrix(~metadata_subset$CO_l.min + metadata_subset[["Age_years"]])
fit.prop <- lmFit(props_subset$Proportions, design)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(5, 5, 3, 1))
plot(metadata_subset$CO_l.min, props_subset$Proportions[10, ], main = rownames(props_subset$Proportions)[10], pch = 16, 
    cex = 2, ylab = "Proportions", xlab = "CO_l.min", cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.5, cex.main = 2.5)
abline(a = fit.prop$coefficients[10, 1], b = fit.prop$coefficients[10, 2], col = 4, lwd = 1)
rm(metadata_subset, props_subset, design, fit.prop)
```

## Cardiomyocytes save percent stats

```{r Cardiomyocytes_save_percent_stats, eval=TRUE}
expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(object = data, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
non_zero_cells <- rowSums(expr_matrix > 0)
total_cells <- ncol(expr_matrix)
percent_cells <- (non_zero_cells/total_cells) * 100
percent_stats <- data.frame(gene = rownames(expr_matrix), percentCells = percent_cells)
write.csv(percent_stats, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Cardiomyocytes_percent_stats.csv"), quote = F, row.names = F)
```

## Cardiomyocytes pseudocounts

```{r Cardiomyocytes_pseudocounts}
pseudocounts <- Seurat2PB(data, sample = "Sample", cluster = "cell_type")
colnames(pseudocounts) <- pseudocounts$samples$sample
```

## Cardiomyocytes filter pseudocounts

```{r Cardiomyocytes_filter_pseudocounts}
percent_stats <- read.csv(here::here(output_dir_data, "Cardiomyocytes_percent_stats.csv"))
rownames(percent_stats) <- percent_stats$gene
keep_genes <- rownames(dplyr::filter(percent_stats, percentCells > 1))
pseudocounts <- pseudocounts[keep_genes, ]
rm(keep_genes)
reactable(percent_stats, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
keep_samples <- pseudocounts$samples$lib.size > 50000
pseudocounts <- pseudocounts[, keep_samples]
keep_genes <- filterByExpr(pseudocounts)
pseudocounts <- pseudocounts[keep_genes, ]
rm(keep_samples, keep_genes, data)
```

## Cardiomyocytes empty objects DE

```{r Cardiomyocytes_empty_objects_DE}
results <- list()
signif <- list()
volcano <- list()
n_de_genes <- data.frame()
```

## Cardiomyocytes DE all

```{r Cardiomyocytes_DE_all}
metadata_DCM_all <- metadata_DCM
saveRDS(pseudocounts, here::here(output_dir_data, "Cardiomyocytes_pseudocounts.rds"))
metadata_DCM <- metadata_DCM[metadata_DCM$Sample %in% colnames(pseudocounts), , drop = FALSE]
pseudocounts_DCM <- pseudocounts[, metadata_DCM$Sample]
all.equal(metadata_DCM$Sample, colnames(pseudocounts_DCM$counts))
for (i in 7:(length(metadata_DCM))) {
    metadata_subset <- metadata_DCM[complete.cases(metadata_DCM[[i]], metadata_DCM$Age_years), ]
    metadata_subset[, i] <- rescale(metadata_subset[, i])
    design <- model.matrix(~metadata_subset[[i]] + metadata_subset[["Age_years"]])
    colnames(design)[2] <- colnames(metadata_subset[i])
    pseudocounts_subset <- pseudocounts_DCM[, metadata_subset$Sample]
    stopifnot(identical(colnames(pseudocounts_subset), as.character(metadata_subset$Sample)))
    rownames(design) <- metadata_subset$Sample
    write.csv(design, file.path(output_dir_data, paste0("A_Cardiomyocytes_design_", colnames(metadata_subset[i]), 
        ".csv")))
    pseudocounts_subset <- normLibSizes(pseudocounts_subset)
    pseudocounts_subset <- estimateDisp(pseudocounts_subset, design)
    fit <- glmQLFit(pseudocounts_subset, design, robust = TRUE)
    fit <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = 2)
    results[[i - 6]] <- topTags(fit, n = Inf)$table
    results[[i - 6]] <- merge(results[[i - 6]], percent_stats[, c("gene", "percentCells")], by = "gene", all.x = FALSE)
    signif[[i - 6]] <- results[[i - 6]] %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>% dplyr::arrange(FDR)
    names(results)[i - 6] <- colnames(metadata_subset[i])
    names(signif)[i - 6] <- colnames(metadata_subset[i])
    write.csv(results[[i - 6]], file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("Cardiomyocytes_DE_Results_", colnames(metadata[i]), 
        ".csv")), quote = F, row.names = F)
    write.csv(signif[[i - 6]], file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("Cardiomyocytes_DE_Significant_", colnames(metadata[i]), 
        ".csv")), quote = F, row.names = F)
    n_de_genes_temp <- data.frame(metadata = colnames(metadata_subset[i]), n_upregulated = sum(signif[[i - 6]]$logFC > 
        0.5), n_downregulated = sum(signif[[i - 6]]$logFC < -0.5), n_tot = nrow(signif[[i - 6]]))
    n_de_genes <- rbind(n_de_genes, n_de_genes_temp)
    keyvals <- rep("grey", nrow(results[[i - 6]]))
    names(keyvals) <- rep("Not significant", nrow(results[[i - 6]]))
    keyvals[results[[i - 6]]$logFC > 0.5 & results[[i - 6]]$FDR < 0.05] <- "#A63A2A"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#A63A2A"] <- "Increased"
    keyvals[results[[i - 6]]$logFC < -0.5 & results[[i - 6]]$FDR < 0.05] <- "#004C8C"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#004C8C"] <- "Decreased"
    volcano[[i - 6]] <- EnhancedVolcano(results[[i - 6]], lab = results[[i - 6]]$gene, x = "logFC", y = "FDR", 
        ylab = bquote(-Log[10] ~ FDR), labSize = 0, titleLabSize = 16, subtitleLabSize = 14, axisLabSize = 12, 
        captionLabSize = 9, pointSize = 0.5, FCcutoff = 0.5, pCutoff = 0.05, ylim = c(0, 3.5), colCustom = keyvals, 
        colAlpha = 1, drawConnectors = FALSE, subtitle = NULL, title = paste0("Cardiomyocytes", "\n", colnames(metadata_subset[i]), 
            "\nn = ", nrow(metadata_subset))) + theme(legend.position = "none")
    names(volcano)[i - 6] <- colnames(metadata_subset[i])
}
write.csv(n_de_genes, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Cardiomyocytes_n_de_genes.csv"), quote = F, row.names = F)
rm(metadata_subset, design, pseudocounts_subset, fit, n_de_genes_temp)
metadata_DCM <- metadata_DCM_all
rm(metadata_DCM_all)
```

## Cardiomyocytes UpSet plot DE

```{r Cardiomyocytes_UpSet_plot_DE, fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
gene_sets <- list()
for (i in 1:length(signif)) {
    gene_sets[[i]] <- signif[[i]]$gene
    names(gene_sets)[i] <- names(signif)[i]
}
m <- make_comb_mat(gene_sets, mode = "intersect", min_set_size = 10)
m <- m[comb_degree(m) >= 2]
m <- m[comb_size(m) >= 10]
ComplexHeatmap::draw(UpSet(m, column_title = "Cardiomyocytes", comb_order = order(comb_size(m)), top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(m, 
    add_numbers = TRUE), right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(m, add_numbers = TRUE)), padding = grid::unit(c(5, 
    5, 5, 15), "mm"))
```

## barplots DEGs

```{r barplots_DEGs, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=10}
n_de_genes <- data.frame()
for (i in seq_along(signif)) {
    parameter <- c(rep(names(signif)[i], 2))
    effect <- c("Upregulated", "Downregulated")
    n <- c(nrow(dplyr::filter(signif[[i]], logFC > 0)), nrow(dplyr::filter(signif[[i]], logFC < 0)))
    de_tot <- nrow(signif[[i]])
    n_de_genes <- rbind(n_de_genes, data.frame(parameter, effect, n, de_tot))
}
n_de_genes <- n_de_genes %>% arrange(desc(de_tot))
n_de_genes$parameter <- factor(n_de_genes$parameter, levels = unique(n_de_genes$parameter))
ggplot(n_de_genes, aes(fill = effect, y = n, x = parameter)) + geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Upregulated = "#A63A2A", Downregulated = "#004C8C")) + theme(text = element_text(size = 15, 
    family = "Arial"), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, family = "Arial")) + labs(x = "Clinical parameter", 
    y = "Number of Genes", fill = "Effect") + guides(fill = guide_legend(title = NULL))
```

```{r Endothelial_cells_pseudocounts}
colnames(pseudocounts) <- pseudocounts$samples$sample
```

## Endothelial cells filter pseudocounts

```{r Endothelial_cells_filter_pseudocounts}
percent_stats <- read.csv(here::here(output_dir_data, "Endothelial_cells_percent_stats.csv"))
rownames(percent_stats) <- percent_stats$gene
keep_genes <- rownames(dplyr::filter(percent_stats, percentCells > 1))
pseudocounts <- pseudocounts[keep_genes, ]
rm(keep_genes)
reactable(percent_stats, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
keep_samples <- pseudocounts$samples$lib.size > 50000
pseudocounts <- pseudocounts[, keep_samples]

pseudocounts <- pseudocounts[keep_genes, ]
rm(keep_samples, keep_genes, data)
```

## Endothelial cells empty objects DE

```{r Endothelial_cells_empty_objects_DE}
results <- list()
signif <- list()
volcano <- list()
n_de_genes <- data.frame()
```

## Endothelial cells DE all

```{r Endothelial_cells_DE_all}
metadata_DCM_all <- metadata_DCM
saveRDS(pseudocounts, here::here(output_dir_data, "Endothelial_cells_pseudocounts.rds"))
metadata_DCM <- metadata_DCM[metadata_DCM$Sample %in% colnames(pseudocounts), , drop = FALSE]
pseudocounts_DCM <- pseudocounts[, metadata_DCM$Sample]
all.equal(metadata_DCM$Sample, colnames(pseudocounts_DCM$counts))
for (i in 7:(length(metadata_DCM))) {
    metadata_subset <- metadata_DCM[complete.cases(metadata_DCM[[i]], metadata_DCM$Age_years), ]
    metadata_subset[, i] <- rescale(metadata_subset[, i])
    design <- model.matrix(~metadata_subset[[i]] + metadata_subset[["Age_years"]])
    colnames(design)[2] <- colnames(metadata_subset[i])
    pseudocounts_subset <- pseudocounts_DCM[, metadata_subset$Sample]
    stopifnot(identical(colnames(pseudocounts_subset), as.character(metadata_subset$Sample)))
    rownames(design) <- metadata_subset$Sample
    write.csv(design, file.path(output_dir_data, paste0("A_Endothelial_cells_design_", colnames(metadata_subset[i]), 
        ".csv")))
    pseudocounts_subset <- normLibSizes(pseudocounts_subset)
    pseudocounts_subset <- estimateDisp(pseudocounts_subset, design)
    fit <- glmQLFit(pseudocounts_subset, design, robust = TRUE)
    fit <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = 2)
    results[[i - 6]] <- topTags(fit, n = Inf)$table
    results[[i - 6]] <- merge(results[[i - 6]], percent_stats[, c("gene", "percentCells")], by = "gene", all.x = FALSE)
    signif[[i - 6]] <- results[[i - 6]] %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>% dplyr::arrange(FDR)
    names(results)[i - 6] <- colnames(metadata_subset[i])
    names(signif)[i - 6] <- colnames(metadata_subset[i])
    write.csv(results[[i - 6]], file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("Endothelial_cells_DE_Results_", colnames(metadata[i]), 
        ".csv")), quote = F, row.names = F)
    write.csv(signif[[i - 6]], file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("Endothelial_cells_DE_Significant_", colnames(metadata[i]), 
        ".csv")), quote = F, row.names = F)
    n_de_genes_temp <- data.frame(metadata = colnames(metadata_subset[i]), n_upregulated = sum(signif[[i - 6]]$logFC > 
        0.5), n_downregulated = sum(signif[[i - 6]]$logFC < -0.5), n_tot = nrow(signif[[i - 6]]))
    n_de_genes <- rbind(n_de_genes, n_de_genes_temp)
    keyvals <- rep("grey", nrow(results[[i - 6]]))
    names(keyvals) <- rep("Not significant", nrow(results[[i - 6]]))
    keyvals[results[[i - 6]]$logFC > 0.5 & results[[i - 6]]$FDR < 0.05] <- "#A63A2A"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#A63A2A"] <- "Increased"
    keyvals[results[[i - 6]]$logFC < -0.5 & results[[i - 6]]$FDR < 0.05] <- "#004C8C"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#004C8C"] <- "Decreased"
    volcano[[i - 6]] <- EnhancedVolcano(results[[i - 6]], lab = results[[i - 6]]$gene, x = "logFC", y = "FDR", 
        ylab = bquote(-Log[10] ~ FDR), labSize = 0, titleLabSize = 16, subtitleLabSize = 14, axisLabSize = 12, 
        captionLabSize = 9, pointSize = 0.5, FCcutoff = 0.5, pCutoff = 0.05, ylim = c(0, 3.5), colCustom = keyvals, 
        colAlpha = 1, drawConnectors = FALSE, subtitle = NULL, title = paste0("Endothelial_cells", "\n", colnames(metadata_subset[i]), 
            "\nn = ", nrow(metadata_subset))) + theme(legend.position = "none")
    names(volcano)[i - 6] <- colnames(metadata_subset[i])
}
write.csv(n_de_genes, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Endothelial_cells_n_de_genes.csv"), quote = F, row.names = F)
rm(metadata_subset, design, pseudocounts_subset, fit, n_de_genes_temp)
metadata_DCM <- metadata_DCM_all
rm(metadata_DCM_all)
```

```{r Endothelial_cells_Volcano_all_metadata, fig.height=9, fig.width=21, dpi=300}
    volcano[[9]] | volcano[[10]] | volcano[[11]] | volcano[[12]] | volcano[[13]] | volcano[[14]]))
```

```{r Endothelial_cells_UpSet_plot_DE, fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
    names(gene_sets)[i] <- names(signif)[i]
}
```

```{r Lymphocytes_DE_all}
    names(signif)[i - 6] <- colnames(metadata_subset[i])
    write.csv(results[[i - 6]], file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("Lymphocytes_DE_Results_", colnames(metadata[i]), 
        ".csv")), quote = F, row.names = F)
    write.csv(signif[[i - 6]], file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("Lymphocytes_DE_Significant_", colnames(metadata[i]), 
        ".csv")), quote = F, row.names = F)
    n_de_genes_temp <- data.frame(metadata = colnames(metadata_subset[i]), n_upregulated = sum(signif[[i - 6]]$logFC > 
        0.5), n_downregulated = sum(signif[[i - 6]]$logFC < -0.5), n_tot = nrow(signif[[i - 6]]))
    n_de_genes <- rbind(n_de_genes, n_de_genes_temp)
    keyvals <- rep("grey", nrow(results[[i - 6]]))
    names(keyvals) <- rep("Not significant", nrow(results[[i - 6]]))
    keyvals[results[[i - 6]]$logFC > 0.5 & results[[i - 6]]$FDR < 0.05] <- "#A63A2A"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#A63A2A"] <- "Increased"
    keyvals[results[[i - 6]]$logFC < -0.5 & results[[i - 6]]$FDR < 0.05] <- "#004C8C"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#004C8C"] <- "Decreased"
    volcano[[i - 6]] <- EnhancedVolcano(results[[i - 6]], lab = results[[i - 6]]$gene, x = "logFC", y = "FDR", 
        ylab = bquote(-Log[10] ~ FDR), labSize = 0, titleLabSize = 16, subtitleLabSize = 14, axisLabSize = 12, 
        captionLabSize = 9, pointSize = 0.5, FCcutoff = 0.5, pCutoff = 0.05, ylim = c(0, 3.5), colCustom = keyvals, 
        colAlpha = 1, drawConnectors = FALSE, subtitle = NULL, title = paste0("Lymphocytes", "\n", colnames(metadata_subset[i]), 
            "\nn = ", nrow(metadata_subset))) + theme(legend.position = "none")
    names(volcano)[i - 6] <- colnames(metadata_subset[i])
}
write.csv(n_de_genes, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Lymphocytes_n_de_genes.csv"), quote = F, row.names = F)
rm(metadata_subset, design, pseudocounts_subset, fit, n_de_genes_temp)
metadata_DCM <- metadata_DCM_all
rm(metadata_DCM_all)
```

```{r Smooth_muscle_cells_DE_all}
pseudocounts_DCM <- pseudocounts[, metadata_DCM_subset$Sample]
all.equal(metadata_DCM_subset$Sample, colnames(pseudocounts_DCM$counts))
for (i in 7:(length(metadata_DCM_subset))) {
    metadata_subset <- metadata_DCM_subset[complete.cases(metadata_DCM_subset[[i]], metadata_DCM_subset$Age_years), 
        ]

        ".csv")))

    signif[[i - 6]] <- results[[i - 6]] %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>% dplyr::arrange(FDR)

    write.csv(signif[[i - 6]], file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("Smooth_muscle_cells_DE_Significant_", 
        colnames(metadata[i]), ".csv")), quote = F, row.names = F)
    n_de_genes_temp <- data.frame(metadata = colnames(metadata_subset[i]), n_upregulated = sum(signif[[i - 6]]$logFC > 
        0.5), n_downregulated = sum(signif[[i - 6]]$logFC < -0.5), n_tot = nrow(signif[[i - 6]]))
    n_de_genes <- rbind(n_de_genes, n_de_genes_temp)
    keyvals <- rep("grey", nrow(results[[i - 6]]))
    names(keyvals) <- rep("Not significant", nrow(results[[i - 6]]))
    keyvals[results[[i - 6]]$logFC > 0.5 & results[[i - 6]]$FDR < 0.05] <- "#A63A2A"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#A63A2A"] <- "Increased"
    keyvals[results[[i - 6]]$logFC < -0.5 & results[[i - 6]]$FDR < 0.05] <- "#004C8C"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#004C8C"] <- "Decreased"
    volcano[[i - 6]] <- EnhancedVolcano(results[[i - 6]], lab = results[[i - 6]]$gene, x = "logFC", y = "FDR", 
        ylab = bquote(-Log[10] ~ FDR), labSize = 0, titleLabSize = 16, subtitleLabSize = 14, axisLabSize = 12, 
        captionLabSize = 9, pointSize = 0.5, FCcutoff = 0.5, pCutoff = 0.05, ylim = c(0, 3.5), colCustom = keyvals, 
        colAlpha = 1, drawConnectors = FALSE, subtitle = NULL, title = paste0("Smooth_muscle_cells", "\n", colnames(metadata_subset[i]),

    names(volcano)[i - 6] <- colnames(metadata_subset[i])
}
```

```{r analysis_87, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
cell_types <- c("Cardiomyocytes", "Fibroblasts", "Endothelial_cells", "Pericytes", "Macrophages", "Lymphocytes", 
    "Smooth_muscle_cells", "Neuronal_cells", "Endocardial_cells")
deg_summary_list <- lapply(cell_types, function(celltype) {
    file <- file.path(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_n_de_genes.csv"))
    df <- read.csv(file)
    df <- df %>% dplyr::select(metadata, n_tot) %>% dplyr::rename(parameter = metadata) %>% dplyr::mutate(cell_type = celltype)
    return(df)
})
deg_summary <- bind_rows(deg_summary_list)
deg_mat <- deg_summary %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cell_type, values_from = n_tot, values_fill = 0) %>% column_to_rownames("parameter") %>% 
    as.matrix()
```

## Cardiomyocytes threshold DE setup

```{r Cardiomyocytes_threshold_DE_setup}
if (!"TAPSE_sPAP" %in% colnames(metadata_DCM)) {
    metadata_DCM$TAPSE_sPAP <- metadata_DCM$TAPSE_mm/metadata_DCM$sPAP_mmHg
}
cm_threshold_contrasts <- list(mPAP_ge35 = list(variable = "mPAP_mmHg", test_fun = function(x) x >= 35, test_label = "mPAP >=35", 
    reference_label = "<35"), TAPSE_lt16 = list(variable = "TAPSE_mm", test_fun = function(x) x < 16, test_label = "TAPSE <16", 
    reference_label = ">=16"), RVIT_ge42 = list(variable = "RVIT_mm", test_fun = function(x) x >= 42, test_label = "RVIT >=42", 
    reference_label = "<42"), TAPSE_sPAP_le032 = list(variable = "TAPSE_sPAP", test_fun = function(x) x <= 0.32, 
    test_label = "TAPSE/sPAP <=0.32", reference_label = ">0.32"))
cm_pseudocounts <- readRDS(here::here(output_dir_data, "Cardiomyocytes_pseudocounts.rds"))
cm_percent_stats <- read.csv(here::here(output_dir_data, "Cardiomyocytes_percent_stats.csv"))
rownames(cm_percent_stats) <- cm_percent_stats$gene
cm_samples <- intersect(metadata_DCM$Sample, colnames(cm_pseudocounts$counts))
metadata_DCM_cm <- metadata_DCM %>% dplyr::filter(Sample %in% cm_samples) %>% dplyr::arrange(match(Sample, cm_samples))
cm_pseudocounts_DCM <- cm_pseudocounts[, metadata_DCM_cm$Sample]
all.equal(metadata_DCM_cm$Sample, colnames(cm_pseudocounts_DCM$counts))
```

## Cardiomyocytes threshold DE

```{r Cardiomyocytes_threshold_DE}
cm_threshold_results <- list()
cm_threshold_signif <- list()
cm_threshold_volcano <- list()
cm_threshold_n_de_genes <- data.frame()
for (contrast_name in names(cm_threshold_contrasts)) {
    contrast_info <- cm_threshold_contrasts[[contrast_name]]
    variable <- contrast_info$variable
    metadata_subset <- metadata_DCM_cm %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[variable]]), !is.na(Age_years)) %>% dplyr::mutate(DE_group = ifelse(contrast_info$test_fun(.data[[variable]]), 
        "test", "reference"), DE_group = factor(DE_group, levels = c("reference", "test")))
    n_test <- sum(metadata_subset$DE_group == "test")
    n_reference <- sum(metadata_subset$DE_group == "reference")
    contrast_label <- paste0(contrast_info$test_label, " (n=", n_test, ") vs ", contrast_info$reference_label, 
        " (n=", n_reference, ")")
    pseudocounts_subset <- cm_pseudocounts_DCM[, metadata_subset$Sample]
    pseudocounts_subset <- normLibSizes(pseudocounts_subset)
    design <- model.matrix(~DE_group + Age_years, data = metadata_subset)
    pseudocounts_subset <- estimateDisp(pseudocounts_subset, design)
    fit <- glmQLFit(pseudocounts_subset, design, robust = TRUE)
    fit <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "DE_grouptest")
    res <- topTags(fit, n = Inf)$table
    if (!"gene" %in% colnames(res)) {
        res <- res %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")
    }
    res <- res %>% dplyr::left_join(cm_percent_stats[, c("gene", "percentCells")], by = "gene") %>% dplyr::arrange(FDR)
    sig <- res %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>% dplyr::arrange(FDR)
    cm_threshold_results[[contrast_name]] <- res
    cm_threshold_signif[[contrast_name]] <- sig
    write.csv(res, file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("Cardiomyocytes_DE_Results_threshold_", contrast_name, 
        ".csv")), quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(sig, file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("Cardiomyocytes_DE_Significant_threshold_", contrast_name, 
        ".csv")), quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
    cm_threshold_n_de_genes_temp <- data.frame(contrast = contrast_name, variable = variable, comparison = contrast_label, 
        n_test = n_test, n_reference = n_reference, n_upregulated = sum(sig$logFC > 0.5), n_downregulated = sum(sig$logFC < 
            -0.5), n_tot = nrow(sig))
    cm_threshold_n_de_genes <- rbind(cm_threshold_n_de_genes, cm_threshold_n_de_genes_temp)
    keyvals <- rep("grey", nrow(res))
    names(keyvals) <- rep("Not significant", nrow(res))
    keyvals[res$logFC > 0.5 & res$FDR < 0.05] <- "#A63A2A"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#A63A2A"] <- "Increased"
    keyvals[res$logFC < -0.5 & res$FDR < 0.05] <- "#004C8C"
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#004C8C"] <- "Decreased"
    cm_threshold_volcano[[contrast_name]] <- EnhancedVolcano(res, lab = res$gene, x = "logFC", y = "FDR", ylab = bquote(-Log[10] ~ 
        FDR), labSize = 0, titleLabSize = 13, subtitleLabSize = 8, axisLabSize = 12, captionLabSize = 9, pointSize = 0.5, 
        FCcutoff = 0.5, pCutoff = 0.05, ylim = c(0, 3.5), colCustom = keyvals, colAlpha = 1, drawConnectors = FALSE, 
        title = "Cardiomyocytes", subtitle = contrast_label) + theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, 
        family = "Arial"), plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8, family = "Arial"))
    ggsave(filename = here::here(output_dir_figs, paste0("Cardiomyocytes_volcano_threshold_", contrast_name, ".png")), 
        plot = cm_threshold_volcano[[contrast_name]], width = 3, height = 4.5, dpi = 600)
}
write.csv(cm_threshold_n_de_genes, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Cardiomyocytes_threshold_n_de_genes.csv"), 
    quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
reactable(cm_threshold_n_de_genes, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
rm(contrast_name, contrast_info, variable, metadata_subset, n_test, n_reference, contrast_label, pseudocounts_subset, 
    design, fit, res, sig, keyvals, cm_threshold_n_de_genes_temp)
```

## mPAP threshold all cell types

```{r mPAP_threshold_all_cell_types, eval=TRUE}
threshold_cell_types <- c("Fibroblasts", "Endothelial_cells", "Pericytes", "Macrophages", "Lymphocytes", "Smooth_muscle_cells", 
    "Neuronal_cells", "Endocardial_cells")
mPAP_threshold_all_summary <- cm_threshold_n_de_genes %>% dplyr::filter(contrast == "mPAP_ge35") %>% dplyr::mutate(cell_type = "Cardiomyocytes", 
    .before = 1)
for (celltype in threshold_cell_types) {
    threshold_pseudocounts <- readRDS(here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_pseudocounts.rds")))
    threshold_percent_stats <- read.csv(here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_percent_stats.csv")))
    threshold_samples <- intersect(metadata_DCM$Sample, colnames(threshold_pseudocounts$counts))
    threshold_metadata <- metadata_DCM %>% dplyr::filter(Sample %in% threshold_samples, !is.na(mPAP_mmHg), !is.na(Age_years)) %>% 
        dplyr::arrange(match(Sample, threshold_samples)) %>% dplyr::mutate(DE_group = ifelse(mPAP_mmHg >= 35, "test", 
        "reference"), DE_group = factor(DE_group, levels = c("reference", "test")))
    n_test <- sum(threshold_metadata$DE_group == "test")
    n_reference <- sum(threshold_metadata$DE_group == "reference")
    if (n_test < 2L | n_reference < 2L) {
        stop("Fewer than two samples are available in one of the mPAP threshold groups for ", celltype, ".")
    }
    threshold_pseudocounts_subset <- threshold_pseudocounts[, threshold_metadata$Sample]
    threshold_pseudocounts_subset <- normLibSizes(threshold_pseudocounts_subset)
    threshold_design <- model.matrix(~DE_group + Age_years, data = threshold_metadata)
    threshold_pseudocounts_subset <- estimateDisp(threshold_pseudocounts_subset, threshold_design)
    threshold_fit <- glmQLFit(threshold_pseudocounts_subset, threshold_design, robust = TRUE)
    threshold_fit <- glmQLFTest(threshold_fit, coef = "DE_grouptest")
    threshold_results <- topTags(threshold_fit, n = Inf)$table
    if (!"gene" %in% colnames(threshold_results)) {
        threshold_results <- threshold_results %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")
    }
    threshold_results <- threshold_results %>% dplyr::left_join(threshold_percent_stats[, c("gene", "percentCells")], 
        by = "gene") %>% dplyr::arrange(FDR)
    threshold_significant <- threshold_results %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05, abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>% dplyr::arrange(FDR)
    write.csv(threshold_results, file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_DE_Results_threshold_mPAP_ge35.csv")), 
        quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(threshold_significant, file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_DE_Significant_threshold_mPAP_ge35.csv")), 
        quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
    threshold_summary <- data.frame(cell_type = celltype, contrast = "mPAP_ge35", variable = "mPAP_mmHg", comparison = paste0("mPAP >=35 (n=", 
        n_test, ") vs <35 (n=", n_reference, ")"), n_test = n_test, n_reference = n_reference, n_upregulated = sum(threshold_significant$logFC > 
        0.5), n_downregulated = sum(threshold_significant$logFC < -0.5), n_tot = nrow(threshold_significant))
    mPAP_threshold_all_summary <- rbind(mPAP_threshold_all_summary, threshold_summary)
}
write.csv(mPAP_threshold_all_summary, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "mPAP_ge35_all_cell_types_summary.csv"), 
    quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
reactable(mPAP_threshold_all_summary, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
rm(celltype, threshold_pseudocounts, threshold_percent_stats, threshold_samples, threshold_metadata, n_test, n_reference, 
    threshold_pseudocounts_subset, threshold_design, threshold_fit, threshold_results, threshold_significant, threshold_summary)
```

## Cardiomyocytes mPAP linear threshold prepare

```{r Cardiomyocytes_mPAP_linear_threshold_prepare}
cm_mpap_linear <- read.csv(here::here(output_dir_data, "Cardiomyocytes_DE_Results_mPAP_mmHg.csv"))
cm_mpap_threshold <- cm_threshold_results[["mPAP_ge35"]]
cm_mpap_linear_sig <- cm_mpap_linear %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05, abs(logFC) > 0.5)
cm_mpap_threshold_sig <- cm_mpap_threshold %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05, abs(logFC) > 0.5)
cm_mpap_gene_sets <- list(`Linear mPAP up` = cm_mpap_linear_sig %>% dplyr::filter(logFC > 0.5) %>% dplyr::pull(gene), 
    `mPAP >=35 up` = cm_mpap_threshold_sig %>% dplyr::filter(logFC > 0.5) %>% dplyr::pull(gene), `Linear mPAP down` = cm_mpap_linear_sig %>% 
        dplyr::filter(logFC < -0.5) %>% dplyr::pull(gene), `mPAP >=35 down` = cm_mpap_threshold_sig %>% dplyr::filter(logFC < 
        -0.5) %>% dplyr::pull(gene))
cm_mpap_overlap_table <- tibble(gene = unique(unlist(cm_mpap_gene_sets)), linear_mPAP_up = gene %in% cm_mpap_gene_sets[["Linear mPAP up"]], 
    threshold_mPAP_ge35_up = gene %in% cm_mpap_gene_sets[["mPAP >=35 up"]], linear_mPAP_down = gene %in% cm_mpap_gene_sets[["Linear mPAP down"]], 
    threshold_mPAP_ge35_down = gene %in% cm_mpap_gene_sets[["mPAP >=35 down"]])
write.csv(cm_mpap_overlap_table, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Cardiomyocytes_mPAP_linear_vs_threshold_overlap_genes.csv"), 
    quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
cm_mpap_overlap_summary <- tibble(comparison = c("Linear up and threshold up", "Linear down and threshold down", 
    "Linear up and threshold down", "Linear down and threshold up"), n_genes = c(sum(cm_mpap_overlap_table$linear_mPAP_up & 
    cm_mpap_overlap_table$threshold_mPAP_ge35_up), sum(cm_mpap_overlap_table$linear_mPAP_down & cm_mpap_overlap_table$threshold_mPAP_ge35_down), 
    sum(cm_mpap_overlap_table$linear_mPAP_up & cm_mpap_overlap_table$threshold_mPAP_ge35_down), sum(cm_mpap_overlap_table$linear_mPAP_down & 
        cm_mpap_overlap_table$threshold_mPAP_ge35_up)))
write.csv(cm_mpap_overlap_summary, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Cardiomyocytes_mPAP_linear_vs_threshold_overlap_summary.csv"), 
    quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
cm_mpap_compare <- cm_mpap_linear %>% dplyr::select(gene, logFC_linear = logFC, FDR_linear = FDR, PValue_linear = PValue) %>% 
    dplyr::inner_join(cm_mpap_threshold %>% dplyr::select(gene, logFC_threshold = logFC, FDR_threshold = FDR, PValue_threshold = PValue), 
        by = "gene") %>% dplyr::mutate(linear_significant = FDR_linear < 0.05 & abs(logFC_linear) > 0.5, threshold_significant = FDR_threshold < 
    0.05 & abs(logFC_threshold) > 0.5, significance_group = dplyr::case_when(linear_significant & threshold_significant ~ 
    "Both", linear_significant & !threshold_significant ~ "Linear only", !linear_significant & threshold_significant ~ 
    "mPAP >=35 only", TRUE ~ "Not significant"), neglog10FDR_linear = -log10(pmax(FDR_linear, .Machine$double.xmin)), 
    neglog10FDR_threshold = -log10(pmax(FDR_threshold, .Machine$double.xmin)), neglog10FDR_linear = pmin(neglog10FDR_linear, 
        50), neglog10FDR_threshold = pmin(neglog10FDR_threshold, 50))
write.csv(cm_mpap_compare, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Cardiomyocytes_mPAP_linear_vs_threshold_all_genes.csv"), 
    quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
cm_mpap_logFC_cor <- cor(cm_mpap_compare$logFC_linear, cm_mpap_compare$logFC_threshold, use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson")
cm_mpap_FDR_cor <- cor(cm_mpap_compare$neglog10FDR_linear, cm_mpap_compare$neglog10FDR_threshold, use = "complete.obs", 
    method = "pearson")
```

## RV state definition prepare

```{r RV_state_definition_prepare}
required_rv_state_columns <- c("Sample", "Age_years", "mPAP_mmHg", "sPAP_mmHg", "TAPSE_mm")
missing_rv_state_columns <- setdiff(required_rv_state_columns, colnames(metadata_DCM))
if (length(missing_rv_state_columns) > 0L) {
    stop("Missing metadata columns: ", paste(missing_rv_state_columns, collapse = ", "))
}
rv_state_metadata <- metadata_DCM %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(required_rv_state_columns)) %>% dplyr::distinct() %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(TAPSE_sPAP = TAPSE_mm/sPAP_mmHg) %>% dplyr::filter(is.finite(mPAP_mmHg), is.finite(TAPSE_sPAP)) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(RV_state = dplyr::case_when(mPAP_mmHg <= 20 ~ "Not overloaded", TAPSE_sPAP > 0.36 ~ "Compensated", 
        TAPSE_sPAP <= 0.36 ~ "Decompensated", TRUE ~ NA_character_), RV_state = factor(RV_state, levels = c("Not overloaded", 
        "Compensated", "Decompensated"))) %>% dplyr::arrange(Sample)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rv_state_metadata$Sample))
rv_state_counts <- rv_state_metadata %>% dplyr::count(RV_state, .drop = FALSE)
rv_state_labels <- stats::setNames(paste0(as.character(rv_state_counts$RV_state), " (n=", rv_state_counts$n, ")"), 
    as.character(rv_state_counts$RV_state))
rv_state_cols <- c(`Not overloaded` = "#BDBDBD", Compensated = "#E38C82", Decompensated = "#9E3434")
write.csv(rv_state_metadata, file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("RV_state_assignments_", "mPAP20_TAPSEsPAP036.csv")), 
    quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
reactable(rv_state_metadata, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
```

## Cardiomyocytes decompensation DE

```{r Cardiomyocytes_decompensation_DE}
cm_decomp_metadata <- rv_state_metadata %>% dplyr::filter(RV_state %in% c("Compensated", "Decompensated"), !is.na(Age_years)) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(RV_state = factor(as.character(RV_state), levels = c("Compensated", "Decompensated")))
cm_decomp_pseudocounts <- readRDS(here::here(output_dir_data, "Cardiomyocytes_pseudocounts.rds"))
cm_decomp_percent_stats <- read.csv(here::here(output_dir_data, "Cardiomyocytes_percent_stats.csv"))
cm_decomp_samples <- intersect(cm_decomp_metadata$Sample, colnames(cm_decomp_pseudocounts$counts))
cm_decomp_metadata <- cm_decomp_metadata %>% dplyr::filter(Sample %in% cm_decomp_samples) %>% dplyr::arrange(match(Sample, 
    cm_decomp_samples))
cm_decomp_pseudocounts <- cm_decomp_pseudocounts[, cm_decomp_metadata$Sample]
stopifnot(identical(cm_decomp_metadata$Sample, colnames(cm_decomp_pseudocounts$counts)))
cm_decomp_group_counts <- table(cm_decomp_metadata$RV_state)
if (any(cm_decomp_group_counts < 2L)) {
    stop("Fewer than two samples are available ", "in one of the RV-state groups.")
}
cm_decomp_pseudocounts <- normLibSizes(cm_decomp_pseudocounts)
cm_decomp_design <- model.matrix(~RV_state + Age_years, data = cm_decomp_metadata)
if (qr(cm_decomp_design)$rank < ncol(cm_decomp_design)) {
    stop("The compensated/decompensated ", "design matrix is not full rank.")
}
cm_decomp_pseudocounts <- estimateDisp(cm_decomp_pseudocounts, cm_decomp_design)
cm_decomp_fit <- glmQLFit(cm_decomp_pseudocounts, cm_decomp_design, robust = TRUE)
cm_decomp_test <- glmQLFTest(cm_decomp_fit, coef = "RV_stateDecompensated")
cm_decomp_results <- topTags(cm_decomp_test, n = Inf)$table
if (!"gene" %in% colnames(cm_decomp_results)) {
    cm_decomp_results <- cm_decomp_results %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")
}
cm_decomp_results <- cm_decomp_results %>% dplyr::left_join(cm_decomp_percent_stats %>% dplyr::select(gene, percentCells), 
    by = "gene") %>% dplyr::arrange(FDR)
cm_decomp_significant <- cm_decomp_results %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05, abs(logFC) > 0.5)
n_compensated <- unname(cm_decomp_group_counts["Compensated"])
n_decompensated <- unname(cm_decomp_group_counts["Decompensated"])
cm_decomp_summary <- data.frame(cell_type = "Cardiomyocytes", n_compensated = n_compensated, n_decompensated = n_decompensated, 
    n_upregulated = sum(cm_decomp_significant$logFC > 0.5), n_downregulated = sum(cm_decomp_significant$logFC < 
        -0.5), n_total = nrow(cm_decomp_significant), minimum_FDR = min(cm_decomp_results$FDR, na.rm = TRUE))
write.csv(cm_decomp_results, file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("Cardiomyocytes_DE_Results_", "Decompensated_vs_Compensated.csv")), 
    quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cm_decomp_significant, file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("Cardiomyocytes_DE_Significant_", "Decompensated_vs_Compensated.csv")), 
    quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cm_decomp_summary, file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0("Cardiomyocytes_DE_Summary_", "Decompensated_vs_Compensated.csv")), 
    quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
reactable(cm_decomp_summary)
```

## Decompensation DE all cell types

```{r Decompensation_DE_all_cell_types, eval=TRUE}
decomp_cell_types <- c("Fibroblasts", "Endothelial_cells", "Pericytes", "Macrophages", "Lymphocytes", "Smooth_muscle_cells", 
    "Neuronal_cells", "Endocardial_cells")
decomp_all_summary <- cm_decomp_summary
for (celltype in decomp_cell_types) {
    decomp_metadata <- rv_state_metadata %>% dplyr::filter(RV_state %in% c("Compensated", "Decompensated"), !is.na(Age_years)) %>% 
        dplyr::mutate(RV_state = factor(as.character(RV_state), levels = c("Compensated", "Decompensated")))
    decomp_pseudocounts <- readRDS(here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_pseudocounts.rds")))
    decomp_percent_stats <- read.csv(here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_percent_stats.csv")))
    decomp_samples <- intersect(decomp_metadata$Sample, colnames(decomp_pseudocounts$counts))
    decomp_metadata <- decomp_metadata %>% dplyr::filter(Sample %in% decomp_samples) %>% dplyr::arrange(match(Sample, 
        decomp_samples))
    decomp_pseudocounts <- decomp_pseudocounts[, decomp_metadata$Sample]
    stopifnot(identical(decomp_metadata$Sample, colnames(decomp_pseudocounts$counts)))
    decomp_group_counts <- table(decomp_metadata$RV_state)
    if (any(decomp_group_counts < 2L)) {
        stop("Fewer than two samples are available in one of the RV-state groups for ", celltype, ".")
    }
    decomp_pseudocounts <- normLibSizes(decomp_pseudocounts)
    decomp_design <- model.matrix(~RV_state + Age_years, data = decomp_metadata)
    if (qr(decomp_design)$rank < ncol(decomp_design)) {
        stop("The compensated/decompensated design matrix is not full rank for ", celltype, ".")
    }
    decomp_pseudocounts <- estimateDisp(decomp_pseudocounts, decomp_design)
    decomp_fit <- glmQLFit(decomp_pseudocounts, decomp_design, robust = TRUE)
    decomp_test <- glmQLFTest(decomp_fit, coef = "RV_stateDecompensated")
    decomp_results <- topTags(decomp_test, n = Inf)$table
    if (!"gene" %in% colnames(decomp_results)) {
        decomp_results <- decomp_results %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")
    }
    decomp_results <- decomp_results %>% dplyr::left_join(decomp_percent_stats %>% dplyr::select(gene, percentCells), 
        by = "gene") %>% dplyr::arrange(FDR)
    decomp_significant <- decomp_results %>% dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05, abs(logFC) > 0.5)
    n_compensated_celltype <- unname(decomp_group_counts["Compensated"])
    n_decompensated_celltype <- unname(decomp_group_counts["Decompensated"])
    decomp_summary <- data.frame(cell_type = celltype, n_compensated = n_compensated_celltype, n_decompensated = n_decompensated_celltype, 
        n_upregulated = sum(decomp_significant$logFC > 0.5), n_downregulated = sum(decomp_significant$logFC < -0.5), 
        n_total = nrow(decomp_significant), minimum_FDR = min(decomp_results$FDR, na.rm = TRUE))
    write.csv(decomp_results, file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_DE_Results_Decompensated_vs_Compensated.csv")), 
        quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(decomp_significant, file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_DE_Significant_Decompensated_vs_Compensated.csv")), 
        quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(decomp_summary, file = here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_DE_Summary_Decompensated_vs_Compensated.csv")), 
        quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
    decomp_all_summary <- rbind(decomp_all_summary, decomp_summary)
}
write.csv(decomp_all_summary, file = here::here(output_dir_data, "Decompensated_vs_Compensated_all_cell_types_summary.csv"), 
    quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
reactable(decomp_all_summary, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, showPageSizeOptions = TRUE)
rm(celltype, decomp_metadata, decomp_pseudocounts, decomp_percent_stats, decomp_samples, decomp_group_counts, decomp_design, 
    decomp_fit, decomp_test, decomp_results, decomp_significant, n_compensated_celltype, n_decompensated_celltype, 
    decomp_summary)
```

## Supplementary data export

```{r Supplementary_data_export, eval=TRUE}
supp_cell_types <- c("Cardiomyocytes", "Fibroblasts", "Endothelial_cells", "Pericytes", "Macrophages", "Lymphocytes", 
    "Smooth_muscle_cells", "Neuronal_cells", "Endocardial_cells")
supp_parameters <- colnames(metadata_DCM)[7:ncol(metadata_DCM)]
supp_data <- list()
supp_data[["Differential_abundance"]] <- differential_abundance
supp_data[["Cell_type_counts"]] <- as.data.frame(props$Counts) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_type")
supp_data[["Cell_type_proportions"]] <- as.data.frame(props$Proportions) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_type")
for (celltype in supp_cell_types) {
    continuous_results <- list()
    for (parameter in supp_parameters) {
        result_file <- here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_DE_Results_", parameter, ".csv"))
        if (!file.exists(result_file)) {
            stop("Missing continuous DE result file: ", result_file)
        }
        result_temp <- read.csv(result_file) %>% dplyr::mutate(parameter = .env$parameter, .before = 1)
        continuous_results[[parameter]] <- result_temp
    }
    supp_data[[paste0("DE_", celltype)]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(continuous_results)
}
mPAP_threshold_results <- list()
decompensation_results <- list()
for (celltype in supp_cell_types) {
    mPAP_threshold_file <- here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_DE_Results_threshold_mPAP_ge35.csv"))
    if (!file.exists(mPAP_threshold_file)) {
        stop("Missing mPAP threshold DE result file: ", mPAP_threshold_file)
    }
    mPAP_threshold_results[[celltype]] <- read.csv(mPAP_threshold_file) %>% dplyr::mutate(cell_type = .env$celltype, 
        .before = 1)
    decompensation_file <- here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_DE_Results_Decompensated_vs_Compensated.csv"))
    if (!file.exists(decompensation_file)) {
        stop("Missing decompensation DE result file: ", decompensation_file)
    }
    decompensation_results[[celltype]] <- read.csv(decompensation_file) %>% dplyr::mutate(cell_type = .env$celltype, 
        .before = 1)
}
supp_data[["mPAP35_DE_all"]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(mPAP_threshold_results)
supp_data[["RV_state_DE_all"]] <- dplyr::bind_rows(decompensation_results)
supp_data[["RV_state_assignments"]] <- rv_state_metadata %>% dplyr::mutate(RV_state = as.character(RV_state))
supp_data[["mPAP_linear_threshold"]] <- cm_mpap_compare
supp_data[["mPAP_overlap_genes"]] <- cm_mpap_overlap_table
supp_data[["mPAP_overlap_summary"]] <- cm_mpap_overlap_summary
DEG_counts <- lapply(supp_cell_types, function(celltype) {
    read.csv(here::here(output_dir_data, paste0(celltype, "_n_de_genes.csv"))) %>% dplyr::mutate(cell_type = .env$celltype, 
        .before = 1)
}) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()
supp_data[["DEG_counts"]] <- DEG_counts
supp_data[["mPAP35_DEG_counts"]] <- mPAP_threshold_all_summary
supp_data[["RV_state_DEG_counts"]] <- decomp_all_summary
saveRDS(supp_data, file.path(output_dir_data, "Clinical_results_for_EV4.rds"))
```
